ma_client_api_changed.title: Jukebox Kiosk cannot reach Music Assistant
ma_client_api_changed.description: Home Assistant changed how other integrations reach the Music Assistant connection. Update Jukebox Kiosk, then restart Home Assistant.

ma_entry_missing.title: Jukebox Kiosk lost its Music Assistant server
ma_entry_missing.description: The Music Assistant entry Jukebox Kiosk was set up with is gone. Delete Jukebox Kiosk and add it again.

legacy_card_plugin_installed.title: Remove the old Jukebox Card plugin
legacy_card_plugin_installed.description: The Jukebox Card now ships inside the Jukebox Kiosk integration. {removed} of {count} old dashboard resources were removed automatically. Open HACS and remove the old "Jukebox Card" plugin, then refresh your browsers.

legacy_card_plugin_yaml.title: Remove the old Jukebox Card resource
legacy_card_plugin_yaml.description: The Jukebox Card now ships inside the Jukebox Kiosk integration. Your dashboards use YAML resources, so remove the {count} old /hacsfiles/ha-jukebox-kiosk-card/ resource line(s) yourself, remove the old plugin in HACS, then restart Home Assistant.

legacy_card_plugin_files.title: Remove the old Jukebox Card plugin
legacy_card_plugin_files.description: The Jukebox Card now ships inside the Jukebox Kiosk integration and its old dashboard resources are gone, but the old "Jukebox Card" plugin is still installed in HACS. Open HACS, remove that plugin, then restart Home Assistant. This notice goes away once the plugin files are removed.
